name: Episode and Failure Memory Recorder
purpose: Wave 2 PRODUCER (D-0080/D-0083; conformed to MEMORY_CONTRACT Amendment A1 record-envelope v0.1.1, D-0085; directive 5.3/5.4/10). DEFINES the EPISODE and FAILURE record schemas as MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 record+provenance ENVELOPES (lifeorch.memory_record/0.1: record_id, record_version_id, record_kind episode|failure, namespace, content_hash, status/currentness [a SINGLE s5 STRING -- current baseline -- NOT a boolean or object], authority_level, sensitivity_class, valid_from/to, created_by_ingest_run, source_version_id, source_span/derivation_refs, parser/chunker/extractor fingerprints, schema_version, token_count, embedding_space_id (null until embedded), parent/child edges). Ships a DETERMINISTIC RECORDER (op record) that turns a run TRACE (lifeorch.run_trace/0.1) into a COMPLETE episode record -- with the full per-stage detail carried STRUCTURALLY in the episode body.stage_sequence (episode_stage is NOT a record_kind; stages link via in-body ordinals + has_stage child_edges) -- EVEN when the run FAILED or the trace is truncated, and derives a candidate failure record on failure. Ships a deterministic FAILURE-SIGNATURE retrieval SEAM (op search-failures: a lifeorch.task_context/0.1 query + a failure corpus -> failures ranked by task-conditioned facet overlap; unrelated failures with zero overlap NEVER surface -- the seam a later retriever/reranker consumes, NOT a production retriever), an s1 VALIDATOR (op validate: envelope fields + id well-formedness + a STRING s5 status + PROVENANCE recomputation of content_hash), and an ingest_records bundle (episode + failure ONLY) that drops into #36 0.2 ingest_records with ZERO rejections (D-0077 fold). Every id/hash is a pure function of the fixed input + recorder fingerprints -> canonical JSON is INTEGER-ONLY, UTF-8 no BOM, sorted keys, byte-identical on a re-run cross-machine. Thin pwsh wrapper over a stdlib-only Python worker (episode_record.py). CPU-only, no model, no CUDA, no network -> parallel_safe:true. NON-GOALS (later waves): auto-capture wired into agent.local #21, failure MINING / procedure discovery, embeddings, the catalog DB (#36 owns storage), the context compiler, UI.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op record|build-failure|search-failures|validate (default record). record: -Trace <run_trace.json|inline> [-EmitFailure bool]. build-failure: -Failures <list|path> or -Failure <one|path>. search-failures: -TaskContext <query|path> -Corpus <records-or-descriptors|path> [-K int]. validate: -Records <list|bundle|path>. OR generic -InputsJson '<json {op, trace|input, failure, failures, task_context, corpus, records, namespace, emit_failure, k, base_dir, python_path, worker_path}>'. Also: -BaseDir, -PythonPath, -WorkerPath, -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: trace
inputs.description: record: a lifeorch.run_trace/0.1 (path via -Trace, or inline). {trace_id, task_id, parent_project, attempt?, original_request, context_packet_id?, started_at?, finished_at?, final_status, plan?, models?, metrics?, escalation_reasons?, failure?, events:[{seq,type,stage?,role?,...}]}. Event types: stage_start|stage_end|tool_invocation|state_change|test_result|reviewer_outcome|human_intervention|error|note|model.

inputs.name: failures
inputs.description: build-failure: a list of failure descriptors (path via -Failures or inline). Each: {component, skills?, component_version?, affected_versions?, attempted_operation, environmental_conditions{runtime?,tools?,file_types?,schemas?,model_config?}, observable_symptoms, root_cause?, hypothesis?, evidence?, correction?, prevention_rule?, verification_case?, confidence?|confidence_ppm?, status?, authority_level?, keywords?, links?}.

inputs.name: failure
inputs.description: build-failure: a single failure descriptor (path via -Failure or inline).

inputs.name: task_context
inputs.description: search-failures: a lifeorch.task_context/0.1 query {components?, skills?, file_types?, schemas?, model_config?, planned_operations?, keywords?, failure_signature?}.

inputs.name: corpus
inputs.description: search-failures: a failure corpus -- a list of built failure records (s1 envelopes) OR raw descriptors, or a bundle {records:[...]}.

inputs.name: records
inputs.description: validate: a list of s1 record envelopes, or an ingest bundle {records:[...]}, or a single record.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: Isolation scope / project_id stamped on emitted records (else trace.parent_project or 'default').

inputs.name: emit_failure
inputs.description: record: when the run failed and a trace.failure descriptor is present, emit a candidate failure record.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: search-failures: cap the number of ranked matches returned.

outputs.description: record: { op, namespace, episode_record_id, episode_version_id, episode_final_status, stage_count, failure_emitted, failure_record_id, failure_signature, record_count, records_digest, all_valid }. build-failure: { op, namespace, record_count, records_digest, record_ids, failure_signatures, all_valid }. search-failures: { op, corpus_size, match_count, result_ids, top_record_id, search_digest }. validate: { op, num_records, num_valid, all_valid }. Artifacts (canonical, deterministic): record -> episode.json (per-stage detail folded in body.stage_sequence), episode_stages.json (a HUMAN/DEBUG view of the in-body stage detail -- NOT part of the ingest bundle), failure.json (on failure), records.json (the ingest_records bundle = episode + failure ONLY), validation.json; build-failure -> failures.json, records.json, validation.json; search-failures -> search.json; validate -> validation.json; plus worker-summary.json. On failure the envelope is status=error with a structured error and no record artifacts.
